title: Dancing at Spanish Fort and the Tuxedo band
summary: Young people danced at the lake; Duerr remembers the Tuxedo band and Bias Dauphin playing there, and family car trips.

story.theme_name: Dance halls, lake camps and riverboat bandstands
story.community_name: Dance halls, lake resorts and where bands played

blocks.x: All the young people used to go out there more or less, and there was dancing out there. There used to be a... I remember the old tuxedo band used to play out the tarantinas out there. Oh yeah? Tarantinas, yeah. Tarantinas, yeah. I think they had a band out there.
Yeah, that was Ridgely and Solestamp's tuxedo band.
And I'll tell you, they played out there too. They had a dance floor out there too. I mean, Bix, not Bix, Bias Dauphin. Yeah. Bias Dauphin used to play out there.
Did you ever go to the Tokyo Gardens, do I think?
No, I didn't go there. Is that the name of the place that they had? It was a dance place. Was that the name of the place? Maybe that's the name of the place?
I think they had a wire fence and everything?
Yeah, I guess it must have been the place. You know Tony Schreiner?
He told me about going out there and he'd climb up on the fence.

Maybe it was a board fence, yeah. Well maybe that's the name of the fence. I didn't know because I didn't, see I'm talking about when I was, well quite young, I mean 12 or 13, you know, my family would go out there sometimes. My cousin and I, they'd take my cousin and me and go out to make this. We moved out here, my father bought an old Dodge. I remember we used to ride out there in the car then.
Oh Steve Lloyd Canna, yeah. I remember Steve Lloyd Canna. I think of some of his names.
